
```jsx
import { CxModalHeader } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxModalHeader from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/modal/CxModalHeader'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **closeButton** | Add a close button component to the header. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
